versions.changelog:
orca 0.5.1

- Added new scripts and tests for handling "ask" and "split" options when blocking Orca new tab behavior.
- Removed the deprecated skill-card.md documentation file.
- Updated existing scripts and tests for improved handling of split/ask logic in tab checks.
- Added dedicated test coverage for pending behavioral issues (test_pr623_orca_pending.py).

orca 0.5.0

- Removed the skill-card.md file.
- Updated scripts for blocking new Orca tab splits and their associated tests.
- Edited and expanded CHANGELOG.md.
- No breaking changes to core skill logic; mostly scripting and doc updates.

orca 0.4.1

- Added a new test script: tests/test-block-orca-new-tab-split-check.sh.
- Updated CHANGELOG.md and resources/block-orca-new-tab-without-split-check.sh.
- Removed skill-card.md.
- Minor internal improvements and file organization updates.

- Added core terminal lifecycle & layout operation examples to documentation (split, rename, switch, close, wait).
- Added new helper and test scripts for session ID resolution and project-blocking features.
- Introduced support for blocking Orca project additions via a new shell script and test.
- Updated version metadata to 0.3.0.
- Cleaned up project by removing outdated skill-card.md documentation.

- Removed the skill-card.md file.
- Updated CHANGELOG.md.
- No changes to the main skill functionality or user-facing features.

- Added shell scripts for blocking Orca "new tab" and "send" actions when required parameters are missing.
- Removed obsolete skill-card.md documentation file.
- Updated CHANGELOG.md to reflect recent changes.

- Initial public release for session management in Orca IDE.
- Supports sending prompts to specific Orca terminal sessions, always disambiguating if multiple candidates match and avoiding sending to the caller's own terminal.
- Enables launching new agent sessions (Claude, Antigravity, OpenClaw, Codex, and more) in new or existing worktrees.
- Provides an install flow to set up the Orca skill bundle in Claude Code, OpenClaw, or Antigravity with options for advanced or standard setup.
- Strong emphasis on resolving and validating the correct Orca CLI executable before executing any commands.
- Does not hardcode CLI flags; dynamically queries the running CLI for up-to-date command references before invocation.
